parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: Retrieves the appointments that have appointment start date before the specified end_date (exclusive of end_date). For example, if you specify start_date as 2020-08-03 and end_date as 2020-08-04, this API will retrieve the list of appointments for only Aug 3, 2020. Note: start_date and end_date must be different.
